samenvatting: The Desync originates in the deliberate introduction of an unsynchronised second pulse (hulpslag) activated on dag 10 at 02:40, after an off-register approval on dag 8 and an unnamed 'hogerhand' approval on dag 9. The second pulse disrupted the single-pulse datanet and was followed by recurrent pre-dawn incidents every four days: shields opened from inside with intact seals, animal unrest, and packet loss. Severity stepped up from 4 to 5 on dag 42, after the dag 24 hulpslag adjustment, without changing the period. Historian timestamp anomalies violate the stated archive rule and remain partly unverified. Remediation must avoid abrupt shutdown, back up all records first, re-synchronise gradually, and patrol the unpatrolled 03:00-06:00 window.

ingreep.bewering: The primary intervention was the activation of a second pulse (hulpslag) by the Engineer on dag 10 at 02:40, after a dag 9 test and an off-register approval. The approval wording matches the Archmage's dag 8 letter verbatim. A secondary escalation followed on dag 24: the hulpslag pulse was raised 5% at 11:00 and the versterking set 5% higher at 11:05, with tempo unchanged.

mechanisme.bewering: The shared baseline is a single Kroonklok pulse, to which every record and shield is synchronised. Introducing a second, unsynchronised pulse put the datanet out of step. Shields opened from inside on dag 10 at 04:47 and on dag 22 at 04:15 with intact outside seals. Animal unrest, packet loss and timestamp anomalies coincided with these openings. The 5% escalation on dag 24 raised severity in the hulpslag subsystem without changing the period.

verloop.bewering: Pre-incident the datanet and the animals were calm: dag 6 quiet, dag 7 within margin, dag 9 quiet nights. Onset followed the 02:40 activation on dag 10 by about two hours, at 04:40-04:50. Incidents recurred every four days (10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42) in the 04:15-04:50 window. Severity was 4 on dag 10 and dag 22, and rose to 5 on dag 42 after the dag 24 escalation. The weekly archmage CSV sampled dags 7, 14, 21, 28, 35 and 42, so only dags 14 and 42 fell on the four-day cycle, giving aliased readings. The 03:00-06:00 unmanned window under GUA-106 meant no patrol observed the true onset.

acties.actie: Explicitly reject abrupt shutdown or ad-hoc freezing of the datanet and the hulpslag.
acties.reden: The Historian's charter warns that if one pulse drops suddenly, records on it are lost, and the Engineer records a council whisper about switching everything off (ENG-111); the Archmage's shutdown recommendation (ARC-112) is unverified.

acties.actie: Make a complete archive, register and log backup before any system adjustment.
acties.reden: HIS-110 makes a register copy the only backup prerequisite before reconnecting the pulses. Storage limits are not stated in any verified record, so capacity must be confirmed before backup.

acties.actie: Re-synchronise gradually in fine-grained steps and revert the dag 24 5% hulpslag escalation.
acties.reden: The fijnregeling adjusts tempo in 0.1% steps (ENG-114, tested ENG-061), while the dag 24 escalation (ENG-029, ENG-062) was followed by severity 5 on dag 42 (BEA-091, BEA-092).

acties.actie: Deploy interim patrols and cross-domain monitoring covering the predicted dag 46 pre-dawn window and the unmanned 03:00-06:00 interval.
acties.reden: Shields opened from inside during the unmanned window (GUA-106, GUA-019, GUA-043), and the four-day cycle predicts dag 46 (ORA-130, BEA-113).

acties.actie: Institute governance safeguards: name the approver of the dag 9 'hogerhand' approval, register the off-register ARC-106 letter, and audit the HIS-035, HIS-036, HIS-053 and HIS-054 timestamps against the HIS-103 rule.
acties.reden: ENG-105 names no approver and matches ARC-106 verbatim; the Historian's anomalies contradict the stated rule (HIS-103), and the dag 22 01:50 melding is corroborated by GUA-115.

risicos.risico: Uninspected internal shield openings during the unpatrolled pre-dawn window while the desync persists.
risicos.mitigatie: Interim patrols covering 03:00-06:00 and gate-opening alarms, per GUA-106 and GUA-043.

risicos.risico: Data loss if a pulse is removed abruptly or the register is reconnected without a copy.
risicos.mitigatie: Complete backup first and gradual reconnection, per HIS-110, with storage capacity confirmed beforehand.

risicos.risico: Unreliable timestamps (vastgelegd_op earlier than gebeurd_op) undermine forensic evidence.
risicos.mitigatie: Audit of HIS-035, HIS-036, HIS-053 and HIS-054 against HIS-103, with no clerical-error conclusion accepted without evidence.

risicos.risico: Political risk from off-register approvals and unnamed higher-authority approval.
risicos.mitigatie: Require a named signer for ENG-105 and register ARC-106, per the governance safeguard.

risicos.risico: Premature removal of woudkabels based on an unsupported 'new cables' belief could cause new disruption.
risicos.mitigatie: Do not remove cables before verification; the cables are documented as unchanged (ENG-003, HIS-105).

voorspelling.bewering: Latest observed incident day is dag 42 (BEA-091 at 04:30, BEA-092 at 04:35). Recurrence period is 4 days (10, 14, ..., 42 per ORA-130 and BEA-113). Arithmetic: 42 + 4 = 46. Expected pre-dawn incident window around 04:00-05:00 if unchanged.
